authorityRules: Only the independently installed TEST observer issuer may sign this family. A signed wire is historical observation, never configuration completeness or business authority.

Association binds the operations installation/candidate/UUID generation and exact signed original recipient bytes/digest/u64 generation independently. These generation domains are never coerced or treated as equal.

Only actual TLS 1.3 peer admission under live Identity/recipient fences and independent PostgreSQL read-only session/query/transaction-lock observation after an exact candidate admission-view read may produce the receipt. PUBLISH, CHECK, LOGIN, socket connection, caller checked flags and health ACKs cannot substitute.

Exact recipient field and required recipient membership derive from installed ownership. One Fact observation cannot clear additional recipients, qualifications, service/unit staged/effective requirements or complete generation.

Current use requires live source revalidation, current installation/candidate/recipient/issuer/workload/instance fences and observer custody; cached sourceDigest or signature alone is insufficient. Expiry, revocation, replacement, failure or UNKNOWN cannot resurrect history.
Version fingerprints are opaque provider version identities; secret material, raw reference names and passwords never enter observations or ordinary readback.
ValidUntil is derived by the observer and bounded by every source authority and the thirty-second observation limit; request values cannot extend it.
